news.title: The AI threat wrecked software stocks. Now financial stocks look next with LPL down 11%
news.description: Financial services firms tanked after the launch of a new AI-powered tax planning tool that promises to do the work "within minutes."

news.title: Estee Lauder sues Walmart alleging 'despicable' sale of counterfeit beauty products
news.description: The counterfeits were sold by third-party sellers on Walmart's marketplace but Estee Lauder alleged the retailer played an active role facilitating those sales.

news.title: Trump Commerce Sec. Lutnick admits visiting Epstein island during family vacation
news.description: Lutnick is facing bipartisan calls to resign following the release of records showing his relationship with Epstein was more extensive than previously known.
